theme: An open day in Dubrovnik before Saturday's charter.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — an open day in Dubrovnik before the sailing course begins Saturday. The only things carrying a clock are the last bits of shore-side logistics, best closed while you still have connectivity.

needsAttention.title: Sailing course boarding details
needsAttention.detail: The Nautilus instructor still needs confirming — boarding time and place on the 12th, plus the return transfer to the airport on the 19th. Once the charter is underway connectivity is poor, so it is a dry-land item.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat wrap-up still open
needsAttention.detail: Three things remain for Sept 19: the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and an early checkout for the 5:15 AM airport run on the 20th. All need arranging before you board.

flagged.title: Valoris–Nomura call still pending
flagged.detail: Marc Lubrano flagged last week that you two still need to connect on the Nomura intermediaries project. Nothing owed today, and it will keep until you are back online.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it is newsletters and travel receipts — Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, JetBlue, napcabs, and the flight and baggage confirmations for Dubrovnik.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and winter squash to the market — a dish that leans into the turn toward cooler evenings.

tasks.title: Book the St Pete landing-gap lodging (Sept 20–22)
Book the Sept 20 – Oct 5 rental car outright

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the morning in Dubrovnik is entirely open.
The last errands before you lose connectivity sit here, whenever you get to them.
Two nights ashore remain before Saturday's boarding.
